anomalies.description: A man in a dark suit engages in a physical fight with another man wearing a striped shirt and cap inside a room with large windows overlooking yachts. The sequence shows the first man grabbing, striking, and subduing the second man using a white cloth or scarf as a weapon or restraint.

A man in a dark suit engages in close-quarters physical combat with another person; he grabs, lifts, and throws the opponent, who is wearing a striped shirt and white scarf, resulting in a violent takedown.

After initial mutual engagement, the man in the suit continues to assault a now-falling or subdued opponent (striped shirt), including grabbing by the neck/scarf and delivering forceful strikes while the victim is off-balance or on the ground, indicating an asymmetrical power dynamic consistent with abuse.

The fight escalates: the man in the striped shirt is thrown or falls backward, colliding with interior structures; the attacker follows through with continued physical engagement, including a visible overhead motion suggesting a strike or takedown. The struggle ends with the striped-shirt man on the floor, partially obscured.
